Remaining half, still this card: the environment's Console sign-in page (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`) renders a returned `?error=access_denied` with the generic "Single sign-on could not be completed — the sign-in link expired or was already used" sentence. It needs its own sentence ("this account is not allowed into this environment") and a switch-account action, with the locale bundles. That is a `ui/` change outside area A1's file surface, so area A1 releases the card back to the queue under `domain:ui` (lease and claim removed).
